observations: The glossy portion of the console's top cover has heavy surface scratching.
A power cable is connected to the rear of the unit.
No television, monitor, or game discs are visible in the photo.
Watermark 'EMEKA EMEKA' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' overlaid on the image.

claims.evidence: The storage capacity is not visible; requires a photo of the 'System Storage' menu.
No physical discs are shown, and no digital library screen is provided.
The console is not shown powered on or outputting a signal to a screen.

risks.risk: The internal hard drive may be 500GB instead of the claimed 1TB.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'Settings > Storage' screen.

risks.risk: Games may be digital titles tied to the seller's personal account, which cannot be legally or safely transferred.
The optical disc drive may be faulty or unable to read discs.
risks.proof: A video showing a disc being inserted, recognized, and launched.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken disc drive

risks.risk: The controllers may have 'stick drift' or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controllers being used to navigate menus or play a game.

proof_requests: Photo of the 'System Information' or 'Storage' screen showing the 1TB capacity.
Photos of the 14+ game discs or a video of the digital library being scrolled.
A video of the console turned on and connected to a TV to verify the HDMI port and disc drive work.
A photo of the model number sticker (e.g., CUH-1215) on the back or bottom of the console.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as an original PS4 console with two controllers. It can be priced based on its visible condition, assuming the worst-case scenario for unverified claims (500GB storage, no games, and potential hardware wear).
